entries.message: Chromium is updated to 156 and now built from Chromium itself with Crest's privacy changes. It sends Google none of your browsing, form or account data, and contacts Google only to keep certificate checks, protected video and your extensions up to date.
Chromium plays protected video that uses Widevine. Netflix, Disney+, Max and Prime Video open in WebKit, which plays them with FairPlay, unless you choose an engine for them.
Chromium allows third-party cookies as Chrome does, except in private windows, so embedded sign-ins and payments work.
Calls in Chromium can use UDP again, so they connect faster and sound better, while sites still can't see your device's local network addresses.
The sidebar's media controls and Now Playing keep showing what you play when a site previews another video under the pointer, as YouTube does on thumbnails.
